title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode1 Opening

rows.Line:
My father has always been my
     aspiration as a musician.

Since I was little, I had this idea of wanting to
perform exciting shows that got people pumped
                  the way my father did.

Those vague ideas finally took shape
      as a dream on that fateful day.
Ever since that legendary night...

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
That's a lot of people.
Is everyone here for KEN and his gang?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Looks that way. It seems that everyone somehow knew that something big was about to go down tonight.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Dad's events were always popular, but this many people is a whole new level altogether...)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: It's starting!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Th-This is awesome! Super awesome, even!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
(It's so much cooler than his other shows...
No! It's the coolest performance I've ever seen in my life!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Look at how many people are totally digging dad and his group's show!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (Everybody's so fired up even though the place is packed... All I want to do is see more!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (This is it.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: (This is the sort of event I want to put on too, one day!)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
(And I'll succeed!
My event will surpass this legendary RAD WEEKEND... There's no way I'm gonna fail!)
Some years later
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here's your coffee!

rows.Speaker: Regular Customer
rows.Line: Thank you! By the way, have you found any other band members yet, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, not yet! I've been working on it but it's a lot harder than it sounds!

rows.Speaker: Regular Customer
rows.Line: But I heard you turned down another artist just the other day? And someone almost about to go mainstream at that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, she was nice, but when I told her my goal was to surpass RAD WEEKEND, she insisted it wasn't possible.

rows.Speaker: Regular Customer
rows.Line: Right... That's a deal-breaker for you.

rows.Speaker: Regular Customer
rows.Line:
I kinda sympathize with her though.
I can't even begin to imagine what an event better than that would be like!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's a normal reaction.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm still gonna do it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, everything's cleaned up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Dad! Cafe hours are over!
I'm leaving now!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Another street performance?
Try not to get into any fights with the other musicians, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Please! I'm not a kid anymore! Anyway, bye!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Be careful!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mic set! All done! Time to start singing.

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, An! We're ready for the show!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: I brought my friend along today, so go for broke!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone! I won't be holding anything back today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Yup. My voice is in top form today!
Time to whip this crowd into a frenzy!)
Oh wow...
She's so cool, singing openly on the street like that... I'd never have the courage...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, I'd say that was a performance well done! I even got everyone to join in as well!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I need more practice...
More importantly, I need bandmates to perform with!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, I'll just have to keep searching!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After all, I'll be holding an event that's going to surpass the legendary RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Did my smartphone just light up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Untitled? I don't remember putting this song in...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! What's this light?!
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What the... Where am I?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Is this a cafe? Hang on...
Wasn't I at the Scramble Crossing just now, though?

Wh-Where am I? Oh no...
I don't recognize this place at all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Who's there?
Eep! I'm sorry, I was just...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, wait! You work here, right?
Can you tell me where this place is, exactly?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This might sound a bit weird, but I have no idea how I got here...

Umm... Me too, actually.
I blinked and suddenly found myself in this place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? You too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Kohane and An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Mi-Miku?!
And... how did you know my name?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey there!
We've been waiting for you two!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're probably still taken aback at how suddenly this all happened. But it's very nice to meet you two nevertheless!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Len and MEIKO are here too?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you kidding me?! There's no way we're having a conversation with Miku, Len, and MEIKO. I've gotta be dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. This is your SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. This SEKAI is a place that your feelings created.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A place created by feelings?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and when you find your true feelings here, those feelings will give birth to songs.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
And that's where we come in!
We're here to help you guys find your true feelings!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Feelings? Songs?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...Look, I'm not trying to be rude here, but I have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! That's only to be expected. It's okay, though. You don't have to understand right away. But you will, eventually!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That goes for both this SEKAI and your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: True feelings...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Do I really have something like that?
I don't even know what I want to do on most days...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's your dream, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... I don't really have one...so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? What about you, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me? It's my dream to surpass a legend!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: L-Legend?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! The legendary event known as RAD WEEKEND that I saw when I was in junior high school!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was such a high point in the music scene that everyone in the community says it'll never be surpassed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I disagree... Because I'm going to surpass it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... You're so cool.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aww, you think so? Thanks! But I'm still a long way off from that goal. I need more training, and more importantly, I need bandmates!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, you never know if you never try!
So I train myself by singing on the streets every night and joining events.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You never know if you never try...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're...right. Maybe if I stopped worrying and started trying, maybe something might change for me too?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Maybe? Just try something out when you're in the mood. Who knows what you'll find?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe... I have no doubts at all that you'll both find your true feelings soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What! This light...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you both have the same feelings, we'll definitely meet in this SEKAI again. So...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Wake up, An. You'll catch a cold sleeping here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? When did I... Wait! It's already bar hours?
I need to get the store ready...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Can't believe I caught you napping here. Long day?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not really... It's just... I had the strangest dream.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, what kind of dream?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think I was talking with someone in it, but I can't remember who it was...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh well! I'll go put up the open sign now!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When did I fall asleep?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That dream I had... I think I was talking to someone... They seemed really nice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't really remember the details though...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I have this feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That something new is about to start.)
